skills.name: idea-interview
skills.summary: Interviews you one question at a time and captures your answers as loose, unstructured fragments.
skills.use_case: You know the topic but have nothing on the page.
skills.description: Interview that pulls raw material out of the user's head as fragments, one question at a time, before any structure exists. Use whenever the user has a topic but a blank page, wants to brainstorm or talk through a piece before writing it, or asks to be interviewed for an article, video, talk or newsletter.

skills.name: draft-shaper
skills.summary: Turns raw notes, fragments or a transcript into a structured article, leaving the source file untouched.
skills.use_case: A voice memo or notes dump needs to become a post.
skills.description: Shapes raw notes, fragments, a transcript or a voice memo into a structured article draft, leaving the source untouched. Use whenever the user has unstructured material and wants it turned into a post, article, essay or newsletter, even when the notes are pasted inline.

skills.name: beat-writer
skills.summary: Builds a piece one section at a time: sets what the reader already knows, offers several openings, then lets you pick the direction at each step.
skills.use_case: A long article or essay where you want control of the path.
skills.description: Writes a piece beat by beat, offering several openings and then a choice of next beat at every step so the author steers the path. Use whenever the user wants to co-write an article, essay, script or story one section at a time, or asks for options at each step instead of a full draft.

skills.name: lesson-series
skills.summary: Plans a multi-part tutorial or course from a learning goal: mission, lessons, reference material and a progress record.
skills.use_case: Turning what you know into a course or tutorial series.
skills.description: Plans and writes a multi-part tutorial or course from a learning goal, with a mission, sequenced lessons, reference material and a progress record kept across sessions. Use whenever the user wants to build a course, tutorial series, workshop, email course or lesson plan, or to continue one already started.

skills.name: seo-checkup
skills.summary: Audits a site across crawlability, indexing, technical performance, on-page elements and content authority, then ranks the fixes.
skills.use_case: Traffic is flat and you want to know why.
skills.description: SEO checkup that audits a website across crawlability, indexing, technical performance, on-page elements and content authority, then ranks the fixes. Use whenever the user asks why a site or page gets little search traffic or is not ranking, wants an SEO audit or review, or is about to launch or migrate a site, even when only a URL or one page's source is given.

skills.name: explainer-video
skills.summary: Plans a teaching narrative and writes a faceless explainer scene by scene: narration, visuals, timing.
skills.use_case: Explaining a topic on video with no camera footage.
skills.description: Faceless explainer video planned as a teaching narrative and written scene by scene with narration, visuals and timing. Use whenever the user wants to explain a topic on video without appearing on camera, needs a script and storyboard for an explainer, or wants an article or idea turned into a narrated video.

skills.name: talking-head-graphics
skills.summary: Plans titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes and picture-in-picture panels, each timed to what is said.
skills.use_case: Dressing up a finished talking-head recording.
skills.description: Cue sheet of on-screen graphics for a talking-head video, with titles, lower-thirds, callouts, quotes and picture-in-picture panels each timed to what is being said. Use whenever the user has a recorded video, interview, podcast clip or its transcript and wants graphics, overlays, text callouts or b-roll planned for it.

skills.name: caption-maker
skills.summary: Produces a caption file from a transcript, in a clean subtitle style or a styled, animated one, and checks it against readability limits.
skills.use_case: Any voiceover or explainer going to social platforms.
skills.description: Captions built from a transcript as a subtitle file, in a clean standard style or a styled animated one. Use whenever the user wants captions or subtitles for a video, needs an SRT or VTT file made or fixed, or wants word-by-word captions for short-form video.

skills.name: motion-graphic
skills.summary: Designs a short animated graphic, under ten seconds, where the motion carries the message, and builds it as a runnable animation.
skills.use_case: A logo sting, stat reveal or animated title.
skills.description: Short motion graphic, under ten seconds and without narration, designed so the movement carries the message and built as a runnable animation with a timing spec. Use whenever the user wants an animated title, logo sting, stat reveal, lower-third animation, animated chart or looping graphic for a video or post.

skills.name: image-prompt
skills.summary: Chooses the kind of image model for the job and writes prompts for generating or editing images.
skills.description: Image prompts written for AI image models, with the right kind of model chosen for the job and distinct concept variants for generating or editing. Use whenever the user wants a prompt for an AI image, a thumbnail, post image, illustration or product shot made with an image generator, or an existing image edited with one.

skills.name: video-prompt
skills.summary: Writes shot-by-shot prompts for text-to-video and image-to-video models.
skills.use_case: B-roll or short clips you cannot film.
skills.description: Shot-by-shot prompts for AI video models, covering text-to-video and image-to-video, with one action and one camera move per shot. Use whenever the user wants a prompt for an AI video generator, needs b-roll or a short clip they cannot film, or wants a scene or script broken into generated shots.

skills.name: avatar-video
skills.summary: Writes the script and voice direction for an AI presenter video.
skills.use_case: A talking-head video without recording yourself.
skills.description: Script and voice direction for an AI presenter video, written for the ear and split into takes an avatar tool can render. Use whenever the user wants a talking-head video made with an AI avatar or cloned voice, a script for a digital presenter or text-to-speech voiceover, or an article turned into a presenter-led video.

skills.name: brand-kit
skills.summary: Develops a brand identity: logo directions, palette, type and a guidelines board.
skills.use_case: Starting a channel, newsletter or product.
skills.description: Brand kit that develops an identity from positioning through logo directions, color palette, typography and usage rules, delivered as a guidelines board. Use whenever the user is starting a channel, newsletter, podcast, product or business and wants a brand identity, logo ideas, a color palette, a style guide or brand guidelines.
